structuredLeadMetadata.metadata_source_notes: Checked the official homepage, menu, contact, hours, about/story, OrderStart storefront, official testimonials page, culinary trainee page, and separate FratosCatering.com site. Google rating/review count and Google review themes were intentionally not checked in this gate. Current owner name remains unavailable from captured public sources.

pagesCaptured.notes: Homepage carries phone, address, media mentions, ordering, specials, hours, story links, and footer theme/login exposure.
Rich text menu with pizza, slices, burgers, wings, tenders, halal notes, prices, and multiple order prompts.
Official order path redirects to OrderStart/Lavu storefront with pickup, curbside, dine-in, delivery choices.
Contact page verifies phone, address, route planner, contact form, FratosPizza@gmail.com owner-directed mailto, and management footer email.
Hours page verifies full kitchen, cafe/gaming, holiday caveats, and call-ahead note.
About page verifies 1975 history, scratch cooking transformation, Chef Ed, Chef Andy/Joe, catering-company-that-owns-a-restaurant story, media mentions, and positioning.
Separate catering site verifies personal chef catering, catering hotline/email, inquiry form, menu, corporate/wedding/event catering, and on-time guarantee.

opportunities.finding: The homepage contains the right order/call/address proof, but the first screen competes with background imagery, stacked promos, and many CTAs.
opportunities.opportunity: Make a clean food-first hero with Order Online, Call, Directions, and Catering CTAs plus the strongest one-line story. Preserve OrderStart rather than replacing operations.

opportunities.finding: Frato's strongest assets — 1975 history, student-chef pipeline, scratch cooking, media mentions, and catering company model — are spread across deeper pages.
opportunities.opportunity: Surface a concise trust/story band near the top: 'Since 1975', media logos, scratch kitchen, culinary students into chefs, and catering proof.

opportunities.finding: Mobile home/menu/catering pages are extremely long; OrderStart mobile has small horizontal overflow and account/login controls before the cart/task feels obvious.
opportunities.opportunity: Use sticky mobile CTAs and shortened category modules that jump to order/menu/call/catering. Keep the external OrderStart path but make the pre-click decision simpler.

opportunities.finding: The menu is rich and specific but presented as a very long all-at-once document.
opportunities.opportunity: Curate signature cards for mozzarella sticks, 1-pound slices, specialty burgers, wings/halal, and monthly specials before the full menu/order handoff.

opportunities.finding: Restaurant ordering, contact, catering inquiry, and catering ordering are split across multiple domains/emails/links.
opportunities.opportunity: Create clear routing: Order Food, Call Restaurant, Get Directions, Catering Quote, Catering Menu, and Contact Management, each with verified destination.

opportunities.finding: Footer theme/login links and page-count artifacts make the current site feel dated despite active 2026 content.
opportunities.opportunity: Remove template artifacts, reduce duplicate nav/footer clutter, and turn active specials into a polished freshness signal rather than a blog archive wall.

reviewThemes.summary: The oversized mozzarella stick is the dominant viral hook and shows up repeatedly as the reason people tried Frato's.
Guests praise large portions, handmade/fresh preparation, burgers, pizza slices, gyros, mac and cheese, wings, tenders, potato wedges, and shakes.
Reviews frame Frato's as a playful comfort-food kitchen with burgers of the month, gyro pizza, ghost pepper wings, grilled cheese builds, and custom pizzas.
Multiple reviews name staff/service as warm, helpful, quick, and welcoming, with named staff mentions in local evidence only.
Customers mention checkerboard floors/tables, games while waiting, TVs/trivia/funny videos, retro/vintage feel, and slots/gaming for adults.
Reviews highlight reasonable prices, big portions, no/short waits, free refills, easy online ordering, parking, and kid-friendly table games.

reviewSourceSafetyNote: Use anonymous aggregate review proof in public site copy; keep reviewer names, dates, avatars, and source details local only.

templateRouting.rationale_summary: Frato's is an order-first casual pizza/comfort-food kitchen with giant mozzarella stick proof, OrderStart conversion, catering, and verified Google proof; pepper-01 matches pizza/wings/burger/takeout economics and playful dish-forward conversion.
